steps.text: Click "Add" to open the dialog that creates a new sharing operation inside the active community.
steps.title: Add an operation

steps.text: Type a meaningful name for the new sharing operation. This name appears in the list and in every reference to the operation.
steps.title: Name the operation

steps.text: Pick the "Local" card to indicate that sharing happens inside a single building, as opposed to remote sharing across the public grid.
steps.title: Local type

steps.text: Type the first letters of a municipality the operation covers.
steps.title: Search a municipality

steps.text: Pick the municipality from the suggestions.
steps.title: Pick the municipality

steps.text: Submit the form to create the sharing operation.
steps.title: Create the operation

steps.text: The new "E2E Sharing Op" shows up in the community's sharing operations list, ready to be edited and activated.
steps.title: Operation created

steps.text: Click the new operation's row to open its detail page and access the full set of parameters.
steps.title: Open the detail

steps.text: The detail page header echoes the name of the operation you just created — it serves as the anchor across every view that references it.
steps.title: Operation name
